description: Tanzania - TANESCO Power Systems is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower, Thermal power", published or maintained by Naichen Zhao  (World Bank Group). Tanzania Electric Supply Company Limited (TANESCO) is a parastatal organization under the Ministry of Energy and Minerals. The Company generates, transmits, distributes and sells electricity to Tanzania Mainland and sells bulk power to the Zanzibar Electricity Corporation (ZECO) which in turn sells it to the public in islands Unguja and Pemba. Coverage: Tanzania. It has 11 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Hydropower, Thermal power, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2015 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
